# Binary size baselines, in bytes, per target triple.
#
# Checked by .github/scripts/check-binary-size.sh against the `dist` profile
# build. Growth beyond the tolerance (default 5%) fails the build.
#
# These are USER-VISIBLE numbers: omni ships as a single self-contained
# binary, so this is what people download. Before this gate existed the
# binary had reached 28 MB with no [profile.release] section at all.
#
# To change a baseline deliberately:
#   UPDATE_BASELINE=1 .github/scripts/check-binary-size.sh <binary> <target>
# and include the result in the pull request so it gets reviewed.
#
# Format: "<target-triple>\t<bytes>"
#
# Targets not listed here are reported but do not fail, so adding a new
# target does not break the build before its baseline is recorded. The
# shipped targets still need theirs filled in from a CI run; the entry below
# is a local glibc host build, kept as a reference point.
aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu	16486312
